items.item:
3. An agent reading a run whose personal-data read reaches a flow output through
   two functions receives digests and classes for the personal-data values and
   content for the rest; the owner receives all content.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a07_agent_gets_personal_data_as_digest]
statements:
```text
class(function_output) = max(class(received_inputs)) OR open
proof_edge_valid -> reach_class(source) <= accepts(target_input)
value_to_agent AND class = personal_data -> (digest, class) only
lowers_class(function | edge | flow construct) -> never
class(binding_output) = declared_class(binding)
```

verdicts.why: The selected test concretely checks that a declared personal-data binding output remains personal_data through two function outputs, is exposed to the agent only as digests and classes while open data remains content, and is fully visible to the owner. It only proves one valid composition; it does not test rejection of an edge exceeding its target’s accepted class or establish that no function, edge, or flow construct can lower a class in violating cases.
